deltas.title: Benchmark temporal integrity — exact or latest prior, never future
evidence: 2,027 high-confidence contaminated valorisations rows measured: 1,919 Morocco + 108 UEMOA.
685 distinct funds, 10 VL dates.
scrape_indices_daily.js and propagate_indref_range.js both use Math.abs nearest +/-7d.
Historical BENCHMARKS_F3_MAPPING_SCHEMA already specifies last available <= target date.

code_phase.rule: Exact first, otherwise latest source date <= target within declared tolerance; never future.
code_phase.dry_run: Compare current matcher vs new matcher over measured scope; unaffected exact/prior rows must remain identical.

deltas.data_phase: Separate governed phase only after code GREEN: snapshot exact contaminated rows, bounded correction, rollback, dependent benchmark-derived recalculation, post-check.
deltas.blocker: AF-TASK-028 queue claim + governed data-write gate.

deltas.title: Nigeria SEC — transport provenance and fallback price semantics
evidence: Current SEC CSV: 8,627/8,627 source_url present.

deltas.title: ORM/live-schema parity for valorisations
evidence: 15 additive columns exist in live valorisations but are absent from src/models/vl.js.

evidence: Live exact counts: ref_asset_classes=4, ref_geo_zones=29, ref_categories_fundafrica=140, ref_indices_fundafrica=137, ref_index_sources=10.
Current DDL lives in seed_referentiel_fundafrica.js rather than canonical Sequelize migration history.

deltas.title: Additive stable view models before Atomic Design refactor
evidence: getfondbyidmeta is shared SSR SEO dependency across at least seven fund page templates.
getfondbyid is shared across investor/portfolio workflows.
manager/country/performance/risk routes have many direct consumers.
FundAfrica ref APIs are live backend authorities but largely not directly consumed by current frontend.
deltas.rule: Add adapters/shared clients first; migrate one organism/template at a time; preserve URLs, SSR metadata, calculations and legacy APIs until zero consumers.

deltas.title: Strict FX as-of helper without breaking legacy getRate
evidence: Current tests explicitly require getRate(before history) -> first future rate.
Allocation/backtest governance explicitly requires no-lookahead.
Measured Morocco/Tunisia production has zero VL before first relevant FX rate, so no emergency historical rewrite is justified by that prehistory condition.
deltas.target: Add getRateAsOf()/strict mode returning latest <= target and null when no prior; keep legacy getRate behavior until consumers are deliberately migrated.
tests: fixed legal CFA parity handled explicitly outside guessed market fallback
migration_order: legacy consumers only when non-regression proven
forbidden: silently changing getRate existing semantics everywhere
hardcoded market-rate fallback in new strict path
